tools.name: get_journal
tools.description: Returns recent lines from the MT5 Journal log. available=false when the log cannot be read.

tools.name: get_trade_stats
tools.description: Returns aggregate statistics over closed trades: total_trades, win/loss counts, win_rate, avg_profit, avg_loss, profit_factor, total_pnl, expectancy, max_drawdown_percent, sharpe_ratio, consistency_percent.

tools.name: get_pnl_by_symbol
tools.description: Returns P&L broken down per trading symbol. Result: { items: [{ symbol, pnl, trades }] } sorted by |pnl| descending.

tools.name: get_pnl_by_time
tools.description: Returns P&L bucketed into time intervals. Result: { items: [{ period_start, pnl, trades }] } sorted chronologically.

tools.name: check_order
tools.description: Checks whether an order can be placed without sending it. Supports both market and pending order types. Returns { feasible, required_margin, free_margin, estimated_cost, reason? }.

tools.name: get_tick_history
tools.description: Returns a sequence of raw ticks for a symbol. Result: { ticks: [{ time, bid, ask, last, volume }] }.

tools.name: place_order
tools.description: Places a market or pending order on MT5. Defaults to dry_run=true — set dry_run=false to execute live. Pending orders may set expiry (unix epoch seconds) for broker-side expiration; expiry is rejected on market orders. Requires the `trade` capability and inp_AllowTrading=true on the EA.

tools.name: close_position
tools.description: Closes an open position by ticket. Defaults to dry_run=true — set dry_run=false to execute live. Requires the `trade` capability and inp_AllowTrading=true on the EA.

tools.name: modify_position
tools.description: Modifies the stop_loss and/or take_profit of an open position. At least one of stop_loss or take_profit must be provided. Defaults to dry_run=true — set dry_run=false to execute live. Requires the `trade` capability and inp_AllowTrading=true on the EA.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancels a pending (limit or stop) order by ticket. Defaults to dry_run=true — set dry_run=false to execute live. Returns ORDER_NOT_FOUND if the ticket is not in pending orders. Requires the `trade` capability and inp_AllowTrading=true on the EA.

tools.name: partial_close
tools.description: Closes a portion of an open position. `volume` must be less than the full position volume. Defaults to dry_run=true — set dry_run=false to execute live. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "v1" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: close_position, close_all_positions, get_economic_calendar, get_cot_report, get_news, get_sentiment, explain_trade, create_alert, query_journal, get_market_context · Private data: read_ea_logs, get_news, set_equity_guard · Public sink: set_equity_guard, set_prop_firm_rules, write_trade_note, set_news_guard · Destructive: place_order, close_position, modify_position, cancel_order, partial_close, modify_order, close_all_positions, set_breakeven, reverse_position, set_equity_guard, remove_equity_guard, remove_prop_firm_rules, remove_news_guard.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: close_position, close_all_positions, get_economic_calendar, get_cot_report, get_news, get_sentiment, explain_trade, create_alert, query_journal, get_market_context · Private data: read_ea_logs, get_news, set_equity_guard · Public sink: set_equity_guard, set_prop_firm_rules, write_trade_note, set_news_guard · Destructive: place_order, close_position, modify_position, cancel_order, partial_close, modify_order, close_all_positions, set_breakeven, reverse_position, set_equity_guard, remove_equity_guard, remove_prop_firm_rules, remove_news_guard

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
